about_the_game:
A dark fantasy shooter where the dead know no rest. Journey through nightmarish dimensions where survival hinges on magic and firepower. Every upgrade, spell, and choice leads to salvation or demise. Uncover the truth… or let it consume you.

Core Features:

  • Immerse yourself in the grim atmosphere of dark fantasy. Explore ruins of forgotten eras to uncover their ancient secrets. Diverse locations teeming with unanswered questions—until you dare to seek the answers.

  • You’ll need every tool to fend off hordes of the undead. Wield and upgrade a brutal arsenal to survive this unforgiving journey.

  • Every slain undead leaves behind a shard of its soul. Gather them to grow stronger.

  • Face legions of the damned: from twisted abominations to corrupted generals, their flesh rotted to the core by darkness.

  • Unearth secrets, loot treasure-filled chests, and weaponize the world itself against your foes. But tread carefully: death lurks in every shadow, and traps hunger for the unwary.

  • Plunge into a bleak tale of impossible choices. Your decisions will decide the world’s fate—reduced to ashes or shrouded in eternal darkness.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
